What’s new in 3.1.0 (October 22, 2026)#

Bug fixes

  • Bug in MultiIndex.union() and MultiIndex.append() raising ValueError: Mixed timezones detected when a level of one MultiIndex held datetime.date objects and the matching level of the other held timezone-aware Timestamp values (GH 68577)

  • HDFStore.append() now raises TypeError when the appended data and the stored data disagree about a column being timezone-aware, or about the index being a PeriodIndex (or are both PeriodIndex with a different freq); such an append was previously accepted and the rows already on disk were read back as different timestamps or the wrong values (GH 68523, GH 68583)

  • HDFStore.append() now raises ValueError when appending a string equal to the sentinel an existing string column already uses for its missing values, instead of silently reading that value back as missing; because the sentinel can also be longer than the values themselves, appending a missing value to a narrow existing column may now require the table to have been created with a larger min_itemsize (GH 9604)
